text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, how foolish...! It seems I was 
unknowingly repeating the sin of gluttony 
over and over...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Layering intense fervor onto fleeting 
pleasures, drowning in nectar... The 
mortal flesh had devolved into the sheer 
embodiment of insatiable desire.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... If that's the case, the race's 
outcome is already obvious."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ho...? Bold words, my captivating lady. 
However, do not underestimate me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"A fallen angel can never return to the 
pure heavens. However! I am different!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahahaha!! It won't take me seven 
days and seven nights to recreate my true 
self!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Destruction and regeneration of muscle 
cells...! It turns my body heat into 
hellfire and boosts my metabolism...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If you are quite finished, would you 
please step aside?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"No... this is where it starts! I never go 
back on my word! I swear I'll break this 
curse!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Run! Run wild! Go utterly mad! That vital 
surge shall shatter the chains of flesh 
that bind me!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—How do I look, my bewitching lady? Toned 
and sculpted just like Mars itself...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Did you come all the way here 
just to show me?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh! I cannot bear the indignity of 
being misunderstood. The sheer intensity 
of this soul transcends the physical 
vessel itself...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh... Wouldn't that be quite splendid?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tanino Gimlet's diet was a 
success, and she regained her original 
physique.
